items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: You used to come down there when I was a kid and play.

ctx.x: This was a different tree you were talking about.

Yeah, yeah, this tree was down in old Harry's Yard. You used to come down there when I was a kid and play. Oh yeah, I played down in Harry's Yard. I was a kid, used to play down there. Yeah. You see, Harry had that black horse and used to set me up on the horse while they all played music.
That's been good a long time.
